method_selection.citation: standard hyperparameter search practice (random/grid search, Bergstra & Bengio JMLR 2012); package composition per DCNv2/BPR training setups.
method_selection.why: Validation peaks at epoch 8 then declines while training loss continues downward, indicating overfit on this small dataset. This untried card bundles capacity with the required strong regularization, adds the proven ranking objective and temporal recency weighting, and uses half-epoch checkpointing. The package has measured around 0.6047 +/- 0.0003, implying roughly +0.0029 over the 0.6018 parent—enough to plausibly clear epsilon in one iteration—while its internal sweep avoids the severe losses seen with untuned dials.

rejected.reason: Also eligible, but it spends substantially more runtime rediscovering interactions already established by the campaign digest; the targeted package dial search has similar known upside with lower cost.
Requires an accepted tuned-package parent, which the current baseline FM is not.
A closing move requiring a best accepted single-model champion; applying it to the baseline would amplify a weak parent.

expected_delta_basis: The selected package card reports tuned validation primary 0.6047 +/- 0.0003 versus the parent 0.6018, while untuned package settings fall to 0.595-0.602, making internal dial selection essential.

method_selection.citation: KuaiRand schema/research notes; MENU temporal-context item 9
method_selection.why: The parent curve telemetry is missing, so overfit or underfit cannot be established from shape. The temporal split directly supports data-shift: causal session position, gaps, and fine time context can capture next-week transient intent beyond the recency weighting already included in node_001. This is an untried, eligible atomic mechanism with an honest expected gain of roughly +0.001 to +0.005; with 10 iterations left, it is preferable to a premature closing ensemble.

rejected.reason: Already included in the accepted package-dial-sweep parent, so repeating it would not add a new mechanism.
Eligible for data-shift, but has greater sparse-capacity and memorization risk on this small dataset than causal session context.
Measured alive but explicitly a closing move; promising single-model moves remain and the convergence streak is only 1 of 3.

expected_delta_basis: The selected session-time-features card estimates +0.001 to +0.005 from causal transient-intent features, and MENU temporal-context item 9 reports an expected +0.001 to +0.005.
